name: cloche
description: Publish the app your agent just built and share it with a link. Cloche hosts small apps made with AI agents.

interface.longDescription: Cloche is a home for the apps people make with AI agents. Build an app in the chat, publish it with one call, and share it with a link. The people you send it to open the app and nothing else. Sign in happens in the browser; no keys to paste.
defaultPrompt: Put the app we just built online with Cloche and give me the link.
List my Cloche apps and tell me which ones are shared.
Open my last Cloche app and add a due-date column.
